slides.title: Rights council urges protection of civilians
slides.body: EHRCO names Amhara, Gambella, Oromia and Benishangul-Gumuz.

slides.title: What EHRCO reports
slides.body: Civilians were reported harmed, workers abducted and families displaced since September. It names both state security forces and armed groups. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Displaced, without aid
slides.body: In Oromia, people displaced from Gida Ayana woreda shelter in private homes with no humanitarian aid, EHRCO says. It also reports ransom abductions of truck drivers in Benishangul-Gumuz.

slides.title: Its asks
slides.body: Investigate and prosecute those responsible, free abducted workers, and provide food, shelter and medical care. The report says no federal or regional response was included.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate independently. Open aid routes.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
